item.title: Signal Flag Key Fob Set of 5
item.description:
Personalized Signal Flag Key Fob Set of 5 needlepoint patterns, made to order (PDF): One key fob chart per person, each spelling a name in nautical signal flags: up to 5 names in one order, all charted with matching flags. For a wedding party, the grandchildren or a boat crew. The photo shows a full set of 5 names.

Digital preview made from the chart. A digital pattern: nothing is shipped.
